adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.tsx`, the client defines its own `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` as `z.array(z.string().email()).refine(...)` to enforce uniqueness, instead of reusing the server schema. Meanwhile the server route uses `addGuests.schema.ts` where `guests` is only `z.array(z.string().email())` (no uniqueness refine). This is a concrete drift visible in the diff: the API will accept duplicate emails that the UI rejects, and the handler itself (`addGuests.handler.ts`) does not dedupe duplicates within the submitted `guests` array (it only filters out existing attendees / blacklisted), so inconsistent/duplicate input can reach DB and downstream logic.
